value.rationale: For a simple uniform triple system with seven points and equal point degrees, the number of blocks must be divisible by seven. Therefore the seven-block boundary is the natural smallest-support class in a recent open fair-coverage optimization problem, not arbitrary truncation. The theorem classifies every tail law at that boundary and determines the unique stochastic extremizer and sharp second-best gap; source literature only supplies isolated cases and general evaluation formulas.
